atoms.b: When you write an informational text, you should include several things to make it ((++convincing contradicting)) and logical. First, you should have a clear ((++thesis_statement logical_fallacy)) that states your argument. For each claim you make, you should give ((++evidence opinions)) that supports your claim. Naming some ((++facts_and_examples friends_and_family)) is a good way to give evidence and support your argument.
A ((++thesis_statement fact)) is a claim that can be made up of several claims that each must be supported by evidence, facts and examples.
Arguments that use logical fallacies are ((stronger ++weaker)) and cause the author to ((gain ++lose)) credibility.

atoms.text: Read the text and answer the following questions.

1. Women’s History Month is an important celebration every year in March to highlight the often overlooked achievements of women in our society. 2. Some men argue that there should be a Men’s History Month because that is in the interest of true equality. 3. The origins of the Women’s History Month go back to 1981, when the US Congress declared the week of March 8th as National Women’s History Week. 4. With that, the US Congress officially recognised that women’s achievements deserve more attention than they have received. 5. Even though there are just as many remarkable women as there are remarkable men, the majority of schools are named after men. 6. For example, in Philadelphia, 193 schools are named after men, while just 18 are named after women.
